description: This file is a PHP source code for an OpenCart admin controller managing extension modules. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling modules within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin interface.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Controller class for managing extension modules in the OpenCart admin area, providing functionalities to list, install, and uninstall modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the response output to the list of extensions/modules.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language data, reads available modules, checks installed modules, and prepares data for rendering the modules list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a module extension, including permission setup, registering autoloaders, and calling any extension-specific install methods.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a module extension, removing permissions and calling any extension-specific uninstall methods.
